title: Prisma rejects null for a Json field: Type 'null' is not assignable to type 'NullableJsonNullValueInput | InputJsonValue'
symptoms: Type 'null' is not assignable to type 'NullableJsonNullValueInput | InputJsonValue | undefined'.
where: { meta: null } fails type checking with Type 'null' is not assignable to type 'JsonNullableFilter'
cause: A nullable Json column can hold two different nulls, SQL NULL and the JSON value null, so Prisma refuses a bare null and makes you choose. Filters on them also need the explicit equals form.
fix: Write Prisma.DbNull or Prisma.JsonNull, and filter with equals and Prisma.AnyNull. In Prisma 7 import Prisma from the generated client.
apply:
import { Prisma } from './generated/prisma/client'
await prisma.item.create({ data: { meta: Prisma.DbNull } })
await prisma.item.findMany({ where: { meta: { equals: Prisma.AnyNull } } })
